description:
Metadata governing linear integer quantization for GPU texture memory packing.
Enforces documented error bounds and strictly flags data as non-authoritative.

is_eligible_for_exact_query.description: MANDATORY FALSE: Quantized render textures must NEVER be queried as authoritative scientific values.
is_eligible_for_exact_query.title: Is Eligible For Exact Query

reserved_missing_code.description: Dedicated discrete integer code reserved for missing / masked / invalid samples.
reserved_missing_code.title: Reserved Missing Code

scale_factor.description: Multiplicative scale factor applied during quantization: float_val = int_val * scale_factor + add_offset.
scale_factor.title: Scale Factor

theoretical_max_quantization_error.description: Maximum absolute error introduced by quantization: 0.5 * scale_factor.
theoretical_max_quantization_error.title: Theoretical Max Quantization Error
